data.body:
VERIFY-FIRST result: NO WORK NEEDED — this ticket is a duplicate; its entire scope already landed.

Re-measured before acting (2026-08-19):

* PR #129 and PR #130 are both CLOSED (2026-08-17T00:07Z) — dependabot
  auto-closed them when the mirror picked up the landed change.
* The identical scope was implemented under ticket 5a90-ec98-af5a-48d0
  (woodblock-gnatty-xiaosaurus, same title), landed as Gerrit change 1832
  (status MERGED, submitted 2026-08-17T00:07:07Z), commit ef97b9ab3f
  'deps: setup-uv v10 + botocore/json-repair', signed off by
  RebarBotNava <joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com> with trailer
  rebar-ticket: 5a90-ec98-af5a-48d0. That ticket is closed.

Acceptance criteria verified directly against origin/main, not assumed:

* AC1 — 19/19 astral-sh/setup-uv references read
  ae62891fec2bb8e7d6c99fc78c9fec3a63790f8d (v10.0.0); zero v9 SHAs remain.
* AC2 — uv.lock records botocore 1.43.70 and json-repair 0.63.1;
  lockfile revision = 3; pyproject.toml unchanged.
* AC4 — landed as ONE Gerrit change through the normal gates.
* AC5 — both PRs carry the grouped-Gerrit-change comment and were left
  open at the time; dependabot closed them on merge.

No re-application performed: re-running the SHA swap or the re-lock would
be a no-op at best and would risk re-pinning versions that later dependabot
rounds have already moved past. Recommend closing this ticket as a
duplicate of 5a90-ec98-af5a-48d0.
